verdict.rationale: ClickHouse is documented as an open-source DBMS you can run on your own machine as a single binary 'to build, test, and experiment'. It installs via a curl one-liner, and the docs also offer clickhouse-local, clickhousectl-managed local servers and in-process chDB. Community reports confirm single-node and Docker setups work in practice. Missing for 10: explicit CI-test guidance (e.g., official CI recipes or test containers), and an explicit statement that the local engine matches ClickHouse Cloud behavior.
